name: 🤖 Agent task
description: Describe work for the agents to spec, plan and build.
title: [task]:

attributes.value:
This issue feeds the agents: once Dr K adds the `agent` label, the spec agent
brainstorms the design with Dr K here, one comment at a time, and each round of the
spec is linked from its reply. `spec approved` commits it and opens a draft pull
request, where the plan and then the code follow.

attributes.label: Summary
attributes.description: What needs to happen, and why. One or two short paragraphs.
attributes.placeholder: e.g. The backup cronjob still double-gzips the SQL dump — drop the inner gzip so restores match the new rclone image.

attributes.label: Acceptance criteria
attributes.description: What does "done" look like? A checklist the builder (and reviewer) can verify against.

attributes.label: Context & pointers
attributes.description: Relevant apps/components/files, constraints, and links. The more specific, the better the plan.
